reply_text:
I saved Marrow Agrisupply's new inbound lane at Dock 23 to GBrain and confirmed it to Pree in the #central-team thread. GBrain had no earlier note about this lane, so nothing conflicts with it.

Two limits on the note:
- **Who can see it:** It was saved as a private memory under Pree's member page, so not everyone who reads the brain will see it. I chose that because it might otherwise reach people outside #central-team.
- **Duplicates:** GBrain is running keyword-only search right now, so it would only have caught an earlier note worded exactly the same way.

My reply to Pree said "saved it to the account notes." That's a little loose, since the note is private to her memory page rather than on a shared account page.
